BiblicalUsage: Freedom here is the liberty of a woman who is a slave, promised to a man but not yet redeemed. The law says she must not be put to death as an adulteress, because she was not free. The word appears once, in a law that protects someone who has no power of her own.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe this single verse shows the heart of God's law: it bends toward the one who cannot defend herself.
